summary: Iteration 2 focused re-test of new Rules Center + Admin Settings General with regression on core CrewIQ flows. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 21 → 26 tests. Added 4 rules tests (seed count, full CRUD+ack lifecycle with version bump/pin/archive/delete + ack visibility on member dashboard + admin acks endpoint, ack auth required, member cannot create rules -> 403) and 1 general-settings persistence test (household_name/motto/theme_accent PUT + GET). Also hardened flaky transfer test by creating a fresh assignment. All 26 tests pass (100%). Frontend: verified via Playwright against the public URL: colorful sidebar with nav-house-rules present, admin created a new rule (rule-title/body/save-rule-btn) → card visible; 'Who read it' opens acks dialog with Accepted/Pending sections; Settings General accepts household-name, household-motto, accent-violet, save-general-btn and values persist after full page reload; Chore Transfer Rules save-settings-btn works. Member (Willow, PIN 5678, Go button) lands on /app with rules-nudge banner ('4 household rules to read'). Tapped ack-rule-<id> on UI_TEST rule → button replaced with green 'You acknowledged this rule'; dashboard nudge decremented to 3. Admin acks dialog then shows Willow under Accepted. Cleanup UI_TEST rule deleted.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description — a11y console warning only, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1270 lines; splitting into routers (auth, users, chores, assignments, transfers, rules, settings, dashboards) is increasingly warranted.

GET /api/rules currently only returns acknowledged=true when the ack matches the CURRENT version — good — but when an admin edits a rule the version bumps and every member's prior ack silently becomes stale. Consider surfacing a 'Re-acknowledgement required' badge in the member UI (currently members just see the ack button reappear with no context that the rule changed).
SettingsPage.js: the Time Zone input has no data-testid and no validation (free text).
rules endpoint responses include mongo doc but excluded _id — OK. But POST /rules/{id}/pin and /archive return only {ok: true}; frontend refetches list — fine.
Rules ack does not de-dup at DB level (only in-code check by (rule_id,user_id,version)); a unique compound index on rule_acks(rule_id,user_id,version) would be safer under concurrency.
